faqs.question: How do I get a price?
faqs.answer: Send us the item, the quantity and your size or paper preference on WhatsApp. The price depends on those three things, so we confirm them and reply with a quote.

faqs.question: What should I send with my request?
faqs.answer: Your logo as a clear image or PDF if you have one, plus your business name and contact details. If you are not sure what you need, describe your business and we will suggest what to print.

faqs.question: Can I see the design before it is printed?
faqs.answer: Yes. We share the artwork with you to approve before printing starts.

faqs.question: Where do I collect my order?
faqs.answer: At our shop in New Kireita House, 2nd floor, Wing B, Nairobi. Ask us about delivery when you send your request.
